content.text:
The robot is now about 0.2–0.3 m from the red ball, facing it, and I've called rest. It is crouched with the motors off.

The ball was to the left of where the robot started. A red object I saw on the right first turned out to be a bin lid. The last camera image, taken just before rest, shows the ball roughly centered ahead of the robot. I didn't measure the exact distance.
